tasks.description:
Product Overview: This listing presents Magnet Hooks in the selected Silver color and 2 Inches size. The package contains 2 count as stated in the product configuration. The item is intended for suitable everyday projects, organization, work areas, travel preparation, craft activities, or other ordinary uses that match the product type. Review the selected variation before ordering so the received configuration aligns with the planned task.

Material And Configuration: The product is listed with Neodymium Magnet and Steel construction. Color, size, count, and package information are provided as variation details to help distinguish this option from other configurations in the same family. Surface appearance and small dimensional differences may be viewed under different lighting or handling conditions. Compare the listed attributes with the intended application before use.

Use And Organization: Arrange the included pieces according to the planned project, workspace, storage method, or general routine. The product can be kept with related supplies so the selected configuration is easier to identify between uses. Tools, containers, finished projects, display items, and unrelated accessories are not included unless they are specifically named in the package contents.

Package Review: The shipment is based on the selected Silver, 2 Inches, and 2 count option shown in this listing. Check the package contents after receipt and keep the product information for future reference. Store the item in a suitable location between uses and keep separate components organized when applicable. This description focuses on the supplied product configuration and does not include promotional, service, certification, or performance promises.
tasks.bullet_1: Two Magnet Hooks Included: The package contains two silver swivel hooks with round magnet bases and carabiner style clips, providing matching hanging points for compatible steel surfaces around work, storage, or activity areas.
tasks.bullet_2: Compact Swivel Design: Each unit measures about 2 inches in total height with an approximately 0.78 inch magnet base, while the rotating connection lets the attached clip face a practical direction after placement.
tasks.bullet_3: Carabiner Clip Access: The spring gate opens for attaching suitable utensils, keys, cords, gloves, or light accessories, then closes to help keep the item connected while the magnet base remains positioned on a compatible surface.
tasks.bullet_4: Flexible Placement Options: Use the hooks on suitable ferrous metal surfaces near grills, cabinets, refrigerators, lockers, office storage, workshops, or utility areas. Holding force varies with surface thickness, finish, angle, and contact area.
tasks.bullet_5: Surface Check Recommended: Place the full magnet face on a flat ferrous surface and test the intended item gradually before regular use. These hooks are not intended for overhead safety support, climbing, or holding valuable breakable items.
